notes.title: Get your own PlataGO! level into the Nintendo Switch version!
notes.notes:
Submissions now open for everyone!

Players of the Early Access PC/Steam version of PlataGO! have the chance to see their best levels and creations included in the upcoming Nintendo Switch release of PlataGO! 

Game-developers-to-be simply have to upload and tag their game using one of the included themes for the competition in the Steam Workshop and the PlataGO! team will choose the best level creations, looking at aspects like innovation, overall design and playability.

Visit the PlataGO! Steam Workshop here: 
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/about/?appid=732400
